plan.summary: BRO-5873: add commercial entries for the four 2017-20 new Broadway musicals that had none (Summer, Head Over Heels, The Lightning Thief, Beetlejuice).
steps: Head Over Heels: WRAL (Nov 26, 2018) reports up to $14.5M capitalization per an SEC filing and that the show did not recoup; Broadway Journal put it at least $11.6M. Did Not Recoup, reported-loss.

Beetlejuice (2019 Broadway run): Broadway News (Dec 9, 2019) reports capitalization up to $21M per an SEC filing. No Broadway recoupment was ever announced (the national tour recouped, a separate production). Did Not Recoup on no-recoupment-announced.

Summer and The Lightning Thief: no capitalization published in any source found; closed over 183 days ago with no recoupment announced. Did Not Recoup on no-recoupment-announced, capitalization left empty.
